rule_metadata.title: Security Tools Keyword Lookup Via Findstr.EXE

rules.rule_text:
title: Security Tools Keyword Lookup Via Findstr.EXE
id: 4fe074b4-b833-4081-8f24-7dcfeca72b42
related:
- id: fe63010f-8823-4864-a96b-a7b4a0f7b929
  type: derived
status: test
description: 'Detects execution of "findstr" or "find" to search for common names
  of security tools. Attackers often pipe the results of recon commands such as "tasklist"
  or "whoami" to "findstr" in order to filter out the results.

  This detection focuses on the keywords that the attacker might use as a filter.

  '
references:
- https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/03/06/malvertising-campaign-leads-to-info-stealers-hosted-on-github/
- https://github.com/nand0san/av_detect/blob/709085c975aa3bf21a891a8222a367d79931675d/README.md
- https://github.com/websec/Security-Software-Process-and-Driver-Names/blob/ca354790629a3ad266981d7a26adfdd584a6d5ea/README.md
